news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price gain to ₹125, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 10.6x. Average trailing P/E is 26x in the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 3.6% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.27 (vs ₹4.57 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.27 (down from ₹4.57 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹74.5m (down 16% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.21m (down 50% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.7% (down from 17% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 12% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 3% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
